_doc: Techniques proposed for the market folk (schema.md, sect technique schema without lineage). Unpriced proposals. The checker reads only sects/*.techniques.json, so the cast uses stand-ins (huyen_kim, huyen_tho) where these would be the main method; see each build note.

techniques.name: Golden Valley Ledger Canon (Kim Cốc Trướng Kinh)
techniques.concept: Kim Cốc Viên's main method, the fallen merchant garden's (fell 1003). The cultivator keeps the body's qi as a ledger: every breath taken in is entered against one given out, and the method stores the surplus in the dantian as 'credit' that a fight can spend all at once. It rewards long patience and punishes a cultivator who spends before the books balance.

arts.concept: Count every hit taken and every hit given; when the count turns in your favour, the next Metal art lands with the difference as bonus damage.
An Earth debuff that grows each second it is not cleansed, and bursts for its whole sum when it is.

techniques.lore: Kim Cốc Viên pledged its manuals to the banker Quản Doanh Hư in 1002 for a last year of credit. When the garden burned (C174) he sold four copies in Vật Hoa Thị to pay his creditors (N-market_folk-02) and kept the original. One copy went to the Từ house of Thiên Quyền Thị; where the other three went is a hook. Holders: tu_binh_quyen, tu_thien_toan (the Từ copy); quan_phuc_thu, quan_than_ngon (the original).

techniques.name: Second Spring Needle Art (Hồi Xuân Châm Pháp)
techniques.concept: The apricot clinic's needle art, Mẫn Tế Thế's and now Giả Hồi Xuân's. Wood needles carry the healer's qi into a patient's meridians and draw a poison or curse back up the needle into the healer, who must then break it in her own body. In a fight it heals over time and moves debuffs off allies.

arts.concept: Halve one poison batch or one curse on you (its strength, or its time left).
A slow heal that grows stronger the lower the target's health.

techniques.lore: Taught free at the clinic in Hạnh Hoa Thị to anyone who will sit with a patient for a season. Giả Hồi Xuân's secret is what the drawing costs the healer. Holders: gia_hoi_xuan (as her own art; verdant-cycle-scripture is her main), nhieu_tu_uyen, bo_ngoc_cham (the salves only).

techniques.name: Loom of Letters Array Canon (Văn Cơ Trận Kinh)
techniques.concept: Vệ Văn Cơ's own formation craft: Củng Tinh's star-script reworked for hire, so that one grid of figures cut into a seal can be relaid in any ground. The formation master carries his arrays as written figures and stands them in a breath where he has stood them before.

arts.concept: Lay a formation you have laid before in half the time.
Once a fight, your array Field's duration is refreshed.

techniques.lore: Built from the Armillary Array Canon he learned before he left the abbey in 1100 (N-cung_tinh-02). The abbey's array hall calls it stolen craft. Holders: ve_van_co (as aux he runs armillary-array-canon until this is adopted), phong_kinh_sa (wants it).

techniques.name: Censer Smoke Manual (Lô Yên Quyết)
techniques.rank: sold on pill-market stalls; any alchemist with a censer
techniques.concept: An element-free stall manual: how to vent a censer so that what burns in it goes out at a foe. It teaches no cultivation worth the name, only the one art; every alchemist who fights through smoke has a copy.
techniques.lore: Copied and recopied on the pill markets; the oldest copies are said to be pages torn from the Purple Smoke Furnace Canon.

arts.concept: A puff of censer smoke: a small Chaos hit. If a pill is prepared in your pill slot, the censer burns it: you get its effect at half strength, and the foe takes a cloud of 4 debuff stacks per pill grade, for 6 s, of the pill's element (Fire Burn, Wood Poison, Water or Ice the Ice stacks, Metal, Earth, Thunder and Wind their own; a pill with no element smokes as Poison). A pill that would fail gives you nothing, but its smoke lays in full. With no pill it is only the puff.
